# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 03 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch & Private Condo Market

- **Thomson Reserve sells 90.1% at launch, with all 3- and 4-bedroom homes taken up** - Buyers purchased 1,143 of 1,268 homes at an average price of S$2,900 psf over the VIP preview and public launch, making it the year's best-selling new condominium launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/thomson-reserve-launch-sales/)

- **New Orchard Boulevard condo could launch from $3,500 psf after developer pays 8.5% more for land** - Hong Leong Holdings and TID topped five bids at $181.9 million for the Orchard Boulevard GLS site, with analysts expecting new homes to launch from $3,500 psf. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-orchard-boulevard-condo-launch/)

- **The price gap between Central and city-fringe condos is the smallest since 1998** - Prime (CCR) resale condos now cost just 1.19x city-fringe (RCR) ones per sq ft, the narrowest gap recorded since 1998. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/prime-resale-condos-cost-1-19x/)

## HDB Resale Market

- **First S$1.8M HDB resale flat in Singapore recorded in Queenstown** - A 5-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson sold for S$1.818 million, becoming the first flat in Singapore to officially cross the S$1.8 million mark, setting a new record on both absolute price and psf basis for the unit type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

## Land Supply & Resale Volumes

- **Two GLS sites at Chuan Grove and former Raffles Town Club could yield 1,180 homes** - The URA has released two residential sites under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List, potentially adding around 1,180 private homes across Chuan Grove and the Plymouth Avenue/Dunearn Road site. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)

- **Condo resale activity recovers as prices continue to rise in September 2026** - Singapore's condo resale market saw transaction volumes rise 10.8% month-on-month to an estimated 1,093 units in September 2026, with price increases largely driven by stronger performance in the CCR. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)
